title: Trump admin releases footage of mysterious UFO flying over US warship
excerpt: The spooky footage was included in the eight release of files relating to UFOs, ordered by Donald Trump.
content:
Charlie Bradley, James Knuckey

Updated Fri, November 20, 2026 at 9:08 PM UTC

The Trump administration has released chilling footage showing a mysterious object flying over a US warship. The Pentagon said the grainy black-and-white footage was captured from an infrared sensor on board a US Navy vessel in the Middle East in 2020.

A spooky circular light can be seen moving from side to side in the eerie 20-second clip. The footage was made public on Friday as part of the Pentagon's eighth release of the "Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena" files.

A Pentagon official, speaking to The Independent, said there was no further information available about the sighting. They told the outlet: "We are not providing any comment or assessment on the files overall or on any specific file, so that the American people can make up their own minds regarding the files."

The Trump administration started releasing files on UFOs - a topic that has captured the imaginations of people in the US and abroad for some time - in May. The Pentagon had been working on declassifying the documents for years.

But in February, Donald Trump said he was directing the Pentagon and other government agencies to dentify and release files related to extraterrestrials and UFOs because of "tremendous interest".

He said officials would publish "a lot of things that we haven't", sparking huge curiosity. After the first batch of files was released, Mr Trump wrote on his Truth Social platform: "Whereas previous Administrations have failed to be transparent on this subject, with these new Documents and Videos, the people can decide for themselves, 'WHAT THE HELL IS GOING ON?' Have Fun and Enjoy!"

The Trump administration has said the public can draw its own conclusions with the information in the files, which has included old State Department cables, FBI documents and transcripts from NASA of crewed flights into space. The latest release, according to The Independent, also included a 1953 report by a Lockheed engineer who noted an incident he saw from his ranch in California.

Clarence "Kelly" Johnson wrote how he spotted a dark blue "saucer" in December of that year, as well as another object with a "light blue flame or emanation" in a separate sighting in November 1951. Sketches of the reported sightings were included in the documents.
